Quick Answers

Do Mary Jane sneakers run true to size?

Most customers find they run true to size. If you have wide feet, consider sizing up or choosing the Barefoot Comfort style with its wide toe box.

Are these comfortable enough for all-day wear?

Yes — the cushioned insole and flexible rubber outsole make these comfortable for walking, commuting, and light errands. The adjustable strap prevents slipping.

Can I wear them with formal outfits?

Absolutely. The classic retro leather style works well with business casual, dresses, and skirts — not just casual wear.

How do I clean them?

Wipe with a damp cloth for daily care. For deeper cleaning, use mild soap and water. Avoid machine washing to maintain the leather shape and strap.
